subject: maths
question: Upon selling an article at (3)/(7) of the marked price, a loss of 30% is incurred. What is the ratio between the marked price and the cost price of the article?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (S.P) = (3/7) × marked price (M.P)

Loss% = 30%

**Concept used:**

If loss = L%

Cost price (C.P) = (S.P × 100)/(100 - L)

**Calculation:**

Selling price (S.P) = (3/7) × mark
